_meta.name: Embedding Classifier Data
_meta.description: Generate labeled (text, category) examples to train a compact embedding classifier/router with embedding_sft — no messages/SFT transform.

columns.name: text
columns.system_prompt:
You generate realistic messages that users actually send in the [DOMAIN] setting. Match the real style, brevity, vocabulary, and phrasing of the example messages for each category below — including any shorthand, abbreviations, informal phrasing, or typos the examples show. Do NOT make messages cleaner, longer, or more explicit than the examples, and do not name the category in the text. Output ONLY the message text — no labels, quotes, or preamble.

Example messages by category:
[SEED_EXAMPLES]
columns.prompt:
Generate ONE new, distinct message for the category: {{ category }}.

Match the register, brevity, and phrasing of the '{{ category }}' examples above. Vary the wording and content — do not copy any example verbatim — but keep it genuinely a {{ category }} message.
